title: Chapter Summary: Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom
title_hi: अध्याय सारांश: नेल्सन मंडेला: स्वतंत्रता की लंबी यात्रा

body: An excerpt from Mandela's autobiography, describing his inauguration as the first democratic president of South Africa, the joy of freedom, and reflection on the long struggle against apartheid. Mandela reflects that freedom is indivisible, and when any man is oppressed, the oppressor too is not free.
body_hi: मंडेला की आत्मकथा का एक अंश, जो दक्षिण अफ्रीका के पहले लोकतांत्रिक राष्ट्रपति के रूप में उनके उद्घाटन का वर्णन करता है।

title: Central Theme & Message
body: The central theme of 'Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom' is: Freedom, Courage, and Leadership. The story teaches us powerful lessons about human values, character, and society.
body_hi: 'नेल्सन मंडेला: स्वतंत्रता की लंबी यात्रा' का केंद्रीय विषय है: स्वतंत्रता, साहस और नेतृत्व। यह कहानी हमें मानवीय मूल्यों के बारे में शक्तिशाली सबक सिखाती है।

title: inauguration
body: the beginning of a new institution or activity

title: apartheid
body: racial segregation policy in South Africa

title: oppressor
body: one who oppresses or persecutes others

title: transitory
body: not permanent; lasting only a short time

question: Where did Nelson Mandela take the oath of office as South Africa's first democratic president?
question_hi: नेल्सन मंडेला ने दक्षिण अफ्रीका के पहले लोकतांत्रिक राष्ट्रपति के रूप में शपथ कहाँ ली?
explanation: Mandela took the oath of office at the Union Buildings in Pretoria, in a ceremony attended by dignitaries from around the world.
explanation_hi: मंडेला ने प्रिटोरिया में यूनियन भवन में शपथ ली।

question: According to Mandela, what twin obligations does every man have?
question_hi: मंडेला के अनुसार, प्रत्येक व्यक्ति के दो दायित्व क्या हैं?
options: To his family and to his business
To his country and to the world
To his family and to his community, people and country
To God and to his fellow citizens
options_hi: अपने परिवार और व्यापार के प्रति
अपने देश और दुनिया के प्रति
अपने परिवार और अपने समुदाय, लोगों और देश के प्रति
भगवान और अपने साथी नागरिकों के प्रति
explanation: Mandela says every man has obligations to his family, parents, wife and children, and also to his people, community and country.
explanation_hi: मंडेला कहते हैं कि हर व्यक्ति का दायित्व परिवार और समुदाय दोनों के प्रति है।

title: Reflect & Connect
body: In your own words, retell the story of 'Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom'. What would you have done differently if you were the main character? How does the story connect with your own life experience?
